scientific_question: Within the same native NF-kB model, how much realized perturbation response is retained by the chi_bio-bearing local oscillatory carrier, by the complete six-mode local generator, and only by the full nonlinear system?

inherited_scalar_candidate.role: P0-Q model-specific candidate, not broad admission
inherited_scalar_candidate.selection_rule: the unique nonreal conjugate eigenspace already frozen and qualified before this joint test

scalar_carrier.name: chi_bio-associated complex-pair carrier
scalar_carrier.content: the frozen complex-conjugate pole pair plus biorthogonal input and output residues required to realize a response
scalar_carrier.warning: this is not chi_bio alone; chi_bio alone has no absolute timescale or response amplitude
scalar_carrier.construction: right eigenvectors V of J and corresponding rows of inv(V); retain only the already-frozen conjugate pair; no trajectory fitting

modal.name: Chi_bio local modal representation
modal.content: complete six-state local linearization dx = J dx + B du, retaining all six modes

system.name: Bio Chi same-system nonlinear reference
system.content: complete source-native nonlinear six-state reduced model driven by the publication protocols
system.scope: same-model system-level Function/Limit reference, not experimental ground truth

equilibrium_and_io.B_definition: partial f / partial TNF at x_star,u_star
equilibrium_and_io.J_rule: centered finite difference at x_star,TNF=0 using eps^(1/3)*max(1,abs(x_j)); verify unique complex pair and chi against inherited pin

execution.nonlinear_solver: MATLAB ode23s with source equations and piecewise-constant source TNF protocol
execution.linear_solver: exact matrix-exponential propagation on each one-minute interval under the same binary TNF input
execution.pair_solver: exact complex modal propagation using frozen pair eigenvalues and biorthogonal input/output residues

metrics.primary: NRMSE of raw free nuclear NF-kB over 0-10 h, normalized by the nonlinear reference peak-to-trough range for that protocol
secondary: first post-TNF peak time difference where a peak exists under a fixed local-maximum rule
first post-TNF peak amplitude ratio where a peak exists
metrics.fixed_peak_rule: strict interior local maximum on the one-minute grid after TNF onset; no smoothing; first such peak

predeclared_interpretive_rules.representation_adequacy: adequate if median protocol NRMSE <= 0.25 and no protocol NRMSE > 0.50
predeclared_interpretive_rules.material_modal_added_value: full-modal improves NRMSE versus pair carrier in at least 5 of 7 protocols and median NRMSE reduction >= 0.05
predeclared_interpretive_rules.PAIR_CARRIER_SUFFICIENT: pair carrier adequate under the frozen rule; modal/system detail may still add descriptive information
predeclared_interpretive_rules.FULL_MODAL_SUFFICIENT_PAIR_INSUFFICIENT: pair carrier inadequate; full-modal adequate and materially improves under the frozen rule
predeclared_interpretive_rules.NONLINEAR_SYSTEM_REQUIRED: full-modal inadequate under the frozen rule, irrespective of pair performance
predeclared_interpretive_rules.MIXED_PROTOCOL_DEPENDENT: no preceding category applies cleanly or protocol conclusions conflict

claim_ceiling: Same-model P0-Q joint Function/Limit mapping only. This cannot independently confirm chi_bio, cannot establish a universal biological hierarchy, cannot establish chi=1, and cannot substitute for external perturbation/recovery validation.
